fields.description: Issue features editorials and reporting focused on Florida and Miami-area politics and taxation, especially opposition to a proposed sales tax and calls for a public referendum. Coverage includes criticism of the Miami Herald and local business interests, discussion of lobbying and public power/utility issues, and commentary on Miami police matters involving Huttoe. Additional local items address crime and courts (including drunk driving and perjury), labor/employment concerns, gambling/lottery ticket sales, Miami Beach actions against discriminatory advertising, and community features including youth summer programming and sports/entertainment listings and advertisements.
